profile.headline: Senior Engineer @ CellarTracker
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
You'll find me in New York City working as an engineer at CellarTracker working on a platform that merges two of my favorite things -- wine and technology. 

I have experience in a variety of programming languages and software practices and currently work primarily with frontend Javascript frameworks to build beautiful applications. 

If you’re interested in grabbing coffee and talking tech (or wine, food, travel, etc.), please send an email my way.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
>> Implemented customizations and refined current features of client Wordpress site.

>> Developed features for and functional prototypes using an internal Nike front-end web framework.

>> Worked closely with visual and production teams to build a mobile-first web application for a digital Nike retail experience. 

>> Currently on the front-end engineering team for the Nike ID builder where we use the newest + greatest (i.e. React and Redux, webpack, nightwatch, etc.)  to constantly evolve and test the customization experience.

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description:
>> Assisted in strategy, implementation, and creation of emoji set and acted as primary developer for iOS and web application.

>> Facilitated transition to dynamic display system in office using NPR platform.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:

Participating in Java development of Core Product.
